# Roy Shao — Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Roy Shao (Ching-Hsiang Shao), software engineer in Taipei building observability systems, Kubernetes telemetry, and LLM agent workflows. NTU CSIE MS, open to new-grad roles.

## Projects
- Sunbird — Kubernetes telemetry PoC comparing push (OTLP) and pull (scraping) OpenTelemetry collector topologies with a live WebSocket dashboard.
- DCIM agentic workflow — stage-based agent pipeline (initial/controller/computation/reply) regenerating specs for a commercial data-center infrastructure system; similarity over 308 real queries: mean 0.954, median 0.966.
